pages.title: Semiclassical Gravity
pages.text: $(thing)Semiclassical Gravity$()$(br2)Quantum fields on curved spacetime: what can be said with gravity still classical and everything else quantum. Its two tested predictions - gravity on a quantum wave, and a horizon's glow - point past themselves, to spacetime that is quantum too.

$(thing)Insight$(): 260$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Neutron Interferometry, Analog Gravity, General Relativity, Monte Carlo Methods.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Gravity-Phase Record, 4 Hawking Correlation Record.
